caption: The drawing shows a rectangular section with a beige, lightly speckled background. In the top portion, near the upper border, there are two parallel horizontal lines drawn close together across the width. Below these lines, positioned centrally, is a decorative blue motif. The motif consists of a symmetrical arrangement: at the top, there are two curved, elongated leaf-like forms arcing outward, and beneath them are smaller, rounded and oval shapes layered in a descending pattern, with three smaller oval elements at the bottom. The blue shapes are shaded to suggest some dimension, and the overall motif is centered on the beige rectangular section. The rest of the surface outside this rectangle is a plain off-white. To the left below the rectangle, there is a faint inscription that reads "chas. Coseau."
title: Crock
